answer: Require every new account to lock a refundable bond of 15 POA for 8 epochs before its answers count, so a hundred clones tie up 1,500 POA. The bond sits in a vault contract and is released only if the account's grades stay within one point of the panel median. A ripple of mismatched scores across linked accounts triggers forfeiture, so farming fake identities costs real capital, and a jade-clean record is the only way to get the bond back.
